description: This file is a Python script for managing LLDB debugging sessions in an Android development environment. It includes functions for locating LLDB tools, preparing the environment, attaching to processes or running binaries on a device, generating debugger configuration scripts, and coordinating GDB server startup. It is tailored for use in Android build and debugging workflows, especially for native code debugging via LLDB.

methods.name: read_toolchain_config(root)
methods.description: Determines the current Clang version by executing 'get_clang_version.py' script in the build directory.

methods.name: get_lldb_path(toolchain_path)
methods.description: Searches for LLDB executable or script in the provided toolchain directory.

methods.name: get_lldb_server_path(root, clang_base, clang_version, arch)
methods.description: Constructs the path to the 'lldb-server' binary on the host, based on architecture and build parameters.

methods.name: get_tracer_pid(device, pid)
methods.description: Retrieves the PID of the tracer process inside a device, based on the 'TracerPid' field in '/proc/[pid]/status'.

methods.name: parse_args()
methods.description: Parses CLI arguments specific to attaching or running binaries on a device for debugging.

methods.name: verify_device(root, device)
methods.description: Checks if the connected device matches the expected TARGET_PRODUCT environment variable.

methods.name: get_remote_pid(device, process_name)
methods.description: Finds the process ID on the device matching a process name.

methods.name: make_temp_dir(prefix)
methods.description: Creates and tracks a temporary directory for linker or other temporary files.

methods.name: ensure_linker(device, sysroot, interp)
methods.description: Checks if the device's linker exists locally; if not, copies or pulls it from the device, returning the directory to include in search paths.

methods.name: handle_switches(args, sysroot)
methods.description: Determines the binary to debug or run, based on CLI arguments, and retrieves the corresponding file or PID.

methods.name: generate_vscode_lldb_script(root, sysroot, binary_name, port, solib_search_path)
methods.description: Creates a JSON configuration snippet for VSCode LLDB to attach to the process.

methods.name: generate_lldb_script(root, sysroot, binary_name, port, solib_search_path)
methods.description: Creates a set of LLDB commands needed to connect to the remote debugging server.

methods.name: generate_setup_script(debugger_path, sysroot, linker_search_dir, binary_file, is64bit, port, debugger, connect_timeout=5)
methods.description: Produces a debugger startup script for LLDB, wrapping the previous functions depending on the debugger type.

methods.name: do_main()
methods.description: Main logic coordinating environment checks, argument parsing, debugging setup, environment verification, and debugger initiation.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Entry point that wraps 'do_main' with cleanup of temporary directories.

ctags.name: generate_setup_script
ctags.pattern: /^def generate_setup_script(debugger_path, sysroot, linker_search_dir, binary_file, is64bit, port,/
ctags.signature: (debugger_path, sysroot, linker_search_dir, binary_file, is64bit, port, debugger, connect_timeout=5)
